usedFor: Eventzilla holds registrations, and Zendesk Support opens a ticket when “New Registration” runs “Create Support Ticket”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Registration” in Eventzilla, then “Create Support Ticket” in Zendesk Support
bestTemplate.why: Each registration becomes a ticket with requester, priority and tags set, ready for your support team to pick up.

watchOut: “Create Support Ticket” opens a new ticket per run, so “Registration Is Updated” would raise duplicates for one attendee.
